@@U00073@@
It's why I approve your method: tagging along to prod and prick him on, as any self-respecting devil must.

@@U00074@@
(To the ARCHANGELS.)

@@U00075@@
As for you, God’s true and faithful sons, rejoice in the world’s endless living beauty! May the power of Becoming that lives and works eternally, encompass you in the gracious bonds of love, and give to the unstable world of seeming permanence by fixing it in eternal thought.

@@U00076@@
(The heavens close, the ARCHANGELS disperse.)

@@U00078@@
I enjoy seeing the old boy now and again, taking good care to stay on friendly terms. It’s really quite decent of so grand a lord to chat with the Devil in such a human fashion.

@@U00080@@
A narrow, high-vaulted Gothic Chamber. 浮士德 sits restlessly at the desk in his armchair.

@@U00082@@
Here I stand! A fool! I who have studied and crammed Philosophy, Law, and Medicine, and even, oh, God! Theology, from end to bitter end! And what has it got me? Nothing.
translation:
@@U00073@@
这就是为什么我赞成你的方法：跟在他后面刺激和刺伤他，就像任何有自尊的魔鬼必须做的那样。

@@U00074@@
（致大天使们。）

@@U00075@@
至于你们，上帝真实而忠实的儿子们，请为世界无尽的生机之美而欢欣鼓舞！愿永恒存在和运作的“生成”的力量，将你包围在仁慈的爱的束缚中，并通过将其固定在永恒的思想中，给予看似永恒的不稳定世界。

@@U00076@@
（天堂关闭，大天使们散去。）

@@U00078@@
我很高兴时不时地见到这个老男孩，小心翼翼地保持友好的关系。这么大的领主，能用人类的方式和恶魔交谈，真是太有面子了。

@@U00080@@
一个狭窄、高拱形的哥特式房间。 浮士德不安地坐在书桌前的扶手椅上。

@@U00082@@
我站在这里！一个傻瓜！我学过哲学、法律、医学，甚至死记硬背过，天啊！神学，从头到尾！它给我带来了什么？没有什么。
